detail: the long form, year x sector, is the real national income index (1952 = 100) of China's five sectors 1952 to 1988, an exhaustive set of series, without a year column; the example only plots it and no unit is sampled from a population (as AER GoldSilver)

the long form, period x medium, is the Netherlands' real television and radio advertising expenditures, four-weekly 1978 to 1994, an exhaustive pair of series without a date column; the examples compute the extended autocorrelation function of log(tv) (Franses 1998, Table 5.4) and fit no model across the media

the long form, day x metal, is the daily spot prices of gold and silver, an exhaustive pair of series, without a date column; the page fits an ARFIMA model to the absolute gold returns and a VAR(2) to the monthly log prices, and no unit is sampled from a population (as Ecdat CRSPday and Garch)

the long form, year x input, is US manufacturing's cost shares and prices of capital, labor, energy and materials 1947 to 1971 beside the cost index, an exhaustive set of four inputs without a year column; the example only plots it and no unit is sampled from a population

the long form, month x pepper, is the monthly European spot prices of black and white pepper 1973 to 1996, an exhaustive pair of series without a date column; the examples run unit-root tests on the white price and cointegration tests on both, no random effect

the long form, year x state, is the populations of Australia's eight states and territories, the regions that exhaust the country, every ten years from 1917, Aust their total outside the stack; the examples compute each state's growth rate and plot its series, no model, and no unit is sampled (as AER GoldSilver)

the long form, year x region, is the annual area-weighted temperature (seAVt to ausAVt) and rainfall (seRain to ausRain) of Australia's regions, states and the Murray-Darling basin, overlapping series that exhaust the country with its average, beside the SOI, CO2 and sunspot series; no unit is sampled, and the shared page plots bomregions2021's mdbRain and SOI and fits no model

the long form, year x region, is the annual area-weighted temperature (eastAVt to ausAVt) and rainfall (eastRain to ausRain) of Australia's regions, states and the Murray-Darling basin, overlapping series that exhaust the country with its average, beside the SOI, CO2, IOD and sunspot series; no unit is sampled, and the page plots mdbRain and SOI with lowess smooths and fits no model

Jan to Dec stack into one monthly SOI series cut into years (year x month), and NTrain to swRain are the annual rainfall of six Australian regions beside avrain, their area-weighted average; the examples fit arima(detrendRain, xreg = detrendSOI) to the annual series, and no unit is sampled

the long form worker category x investigation (the 1886 Board of Trade census, the 1889 US Bureau of Labor survey) is a 14 x 2 table of worker counts; the 14 categories are an exhaustive classification of the industry's workers, a design factor by the five-level rule, and no column names them; avwage is the survey's alone and the examples only plot survey1889 against census1886.

the long form, year x lake, is the yearly average heights 1918 to 2009 of four lakes (Erie, Michigan/Huron, Ontario, St Clair) 'stored as a multivariate time series', a fixed set of series; the example plots it

the long form, month x region, is the seasonally adjusted monthly labor force counts of six regions that exhaust Canada (BC, Alberta, Prairies, Ontario, Quebec, Atlantic) over 1995 and 1996; the examples plot each region's series, no model, and no unit is sampled (as AER GoldSilver)

the example's reshape(idvar = 'Year', timevar = 'pctile', direction = 'long') stacks the quantiles of US family income (quintile1 to P99.99) and realGDPperFamily, series of one distribution, an exhaustive set, and fits lm(log(value/1000) ~ Year + variable*t1970p), fixed effects only; the years are the time axis and no unit is sampled from a population (as AER GoldSilver)

read1 to read6 and age1 to age6 hold -10 as their missing marker, which the loader keeps as a value (loader limit, #210); the long form pupil x occasion would file reading ~ age + (1 + age | id), section 13.3 of the R2MLwiN demo, which sets -10 to NA

the long form, year x crop, is the gross profit per acre of four crops (carrot, celery, cucumber, pepper) over six years, a few exhaustive series without a sampled unit (as AER GoldSilver's two metals); the example plots each crop's profit by year, solves a linear program for the acreage and searches allocations for the least weighted variance across years, no model

the long form, year x month, is one trial's monthly weather over its ten years (December to April), a single series without a sampled unit, and it holds no response: the example scales the 28 columns as the covariate matrix U of plsr(Z ~ U) on vargas.txe.yield's year x treatment yields; precipitation also lacks April and sun hours March and April

the long form, subject x week, is one survival time per subject (DAYS to cocaine relapse, CENSOR) split by the weekly mood (MOOD1 to MOOD12 as assessed, WEEKMOOD1 to WEEKMOOD12 the last assessment before each week from BASEMOOD on, AVERMOOD00 to AVERMOOD12 with gaps averaged), a time-varying covariate of a single-level Cox model (Singer and Willett 2003, ch. 15, recalled), so ID indexes split records of one survival time, not a cluster (as rabe_hesketh divorce2); the same 104 subjects' weekly person-period relapse is filed as alda cocaine_relapse_pp

the matrix holds each of 469 replicates' firing times of one motorneurone in a window of 250 ms either side of a stimulus (column 2 the last firing before it, column 3 the first after), a point process of 2 to 6 firings per replicate rather than a measure at shared occasions; the page has no examples and the cited Ventura, Davison and Boniface (1997) model the point process (not read). Its columns are unnamed positions (0 to 5) that no stack can name: the loader's reshape refuses '0'

the page calls it 'Contrived data on weight loss and self esteem over three months', modified slightly from a course page; its long form would be individual x month with wl1 to wl3 and se1 to se3 as two measures

the Qualtrics export's two header rows (question text, ImportId) load as data, so every rating column holds the item's text and an ImportId beside the ratings, whose endpoints carry their labels ('1 完全不匹配', '7 完全匹配'), and no declared type loads the rating (as johansson_2020_dryad); 111.Rmd melts the 64 item columns over ResponseId, splits each condition name into ClauseType, Number, LinearOr and Item (four factors in one occasion, a RULE GAP) and z-scores the ratings per participant over the fillers too

fitzmaurice_tlc's tlc.dta with the lead levels at weeks 1, 4 and 6 set to missing by a missing at random process, 'created for illustrative purposes', the mechanism in Fitzmaurice, Laird and Ware (2011, sec. 18.4), as its page says; its observed values are tlc.dta's (the baseline identical), the treatment coded 0/1

its long form, line by environment, holds BLUPs, the per-line predictions of the paper's plot-level LMMs (Eq. 1 to 3) in five environments, not observations; the plot data are not deposited, and the GAPIT MLM takes one environment's column at a time with a kinship effect

The long form trial x arm (events ep1t to ep6t of nt in the high-dose group, ep1c to ep6c of nc in the standard-dose group) groups by trial alone, 4 levels (PROVE IT, A-TO-Z, TNT and IDEAL), a design factor by the five-level rule: four statin trials, below five levels, pooled by rma.mh, a common-effect Mantel-Haenszel method with the trials as fixed strata.
pingouin's datasets.csv describes it as 'Hypothetical data of an agreement between two methods (Method A and B)', after Giavarina (2015, Biochemia Medica); its long form would be subject x method

the long form, orientation x neuron, is three neurons' spike counts at the same 8 stimulus orientations (N1Spikes to N3Spikes); three neurons make neuron a design factor by the five-level rule, the orientations are a fixed design covariate, and 05_CircularStatistics.ipynb fits no model across neurons, only the first neuron's circular mean and Rayleigh test

ecdc0501 cut at 2020-04-01: for each country its deaths and cases up to N[m] equal the first days of posteriordb:posterior_database/data/data/ecdc0501.json.zip, f and SI are equal and the later days hold the -1 padding; both feed covid19imperial_v2 and v3, and both info files carry the title 'until 2020-04-01'

deaths_1 to deaths_14 and cases_1 to cases_14 hold -1 on each country's days past N[m], the padding covid19imperial_v2.stan says to ignore ('the rows with i > N contain -1 and should be ignored'), which no declared type loads as missing, so the count response of the country x day long form is refused; that long form would carry the semi-mechanistic renewal model (NONLINEAR) with negative binomial deaths and a country-level R0 mu ~ normal(3.28, kappa), its interventions X, pop, N and EpidemicStart no columns

the long form marriage x span splits one interval-censored dissolution per marriage by the children in force over each span, as divorce2.dta's spells (filed no grouping structure); marriage indexes split records of one survival time

dep1 to dep6 and pre hold -9 as their missing marker, which the loader keeps as a value (loader limit, #210); the long form subject x month would file the MLMUS4 exercise's random-coefficient model of dep on month and group

the same cumulative vote tallies as ros riverbay, the rosdata package's copy of this file, which riverbay.Rmd reads with header = FALSE; loaded with its first candidate's row as the header, it holds every candidate but that one under column names that are the first row's values

an OECD Health Data sheet that healthexpenditure_setup.R reads with skip = 3: the loader takes its title as the header, so the indicator line, a blank row, the year row and the legend rows load as data rows, and the year row would stack as one country's consultations; the source keeps each country's latest value only

a subset of ros Names/data/SSA-longtail-names.csv: lastletters_setup.R drops the rows of ErrorNames.csv's misgendered or invalid names and writes the rest unchanged, the year columns prefixed X; names.Rmd's per-name trends run on it and are filed on the full table

student_setup.R's outer join (all = TRUE) of student-mat.csv and student-por.csv on thirteen student attributes, binary factors recoded 0/1 and the covariates taken from the math file, so they are missing for the Portuguese-only students; both courses' tables are filed, and no example reads this one

student_setup.R's inner join of student-mat.csv and student-por.csv on thirteen student attributes, the students of both courses, binary factors recoded 0/1 and the covariates taken from the math file; both courses' tables are filed, and student.Rmd's model of the final grade is in their notes

its long form, participant by movie clip (ten clips' answers after the conversation, five with an agreement rating), is fit by nothing: the paper's behavioral distance model ((1 | pair)) runs on pairwise distances computed from these answers, a table no file holds

its long form, participant by movie clip (each clip's open answers, four clip-specific yes or no questions and the happy-ending question, before the conversation), is fit by nothing: the paper's behavioral distance model ((1 | pair)) runs on city-block distances between participants' answers, a pair table no file holds

its long form, conversation group by movie clip (each group's consensus answers to the clips' questions), is fit by nothing: conversation_r.R fits the group-level (1 | movie) models on the alignment changes of derivatives/convo_df, not on these answers

Snijders and Bosker (2012) draw Table 3.1, this sheet's ten groups of ten (Y1 to Y10, the groups as columns, so a row is no unit), as random numbers to show the intraclass correlation of random data (Example 3.1, recalled from the book; the workbook's Contents sheet names only 'data from Table 3.1 on page 19'); the values are integers from 0 to 99 spread evenly, and Table 3.2 on sheet 03B is excluded as artificial alike

the cells are constructed adjustments, the banner's sum of half the region effect, home-state advantage, South, Catholic and candidate-ideology effects per state and presidential election 1948 to 1992, which the scripts of Ch.10 and Ch.14 subtract from or add to a vote share by state and year; the state x election long form holds no measurement and no model fits it

copies posteriordb:posterior_database/data/data/dogs.json.zip, its rows 2 to 31 equal to the 30 dogs, its first row all zeros from dogs.dat's header line (0 to 24), which 24.2_BehavioralLearningExperiment.R's read.table reads as a dog (n_dogs 31)

the long form, dose x plate, is 6 doses with 3 replicate plates each, faraway salmonella's 18 colony counts, excluded alike; salm.stan's only random effect, lambda[dose, plate] ~ normal(0, sigma), is one per count, an observation-level overdispersion term, and the dose x enters as a fixed covariate (log(x + 10) and x) at six levels the experimenter chose (salm2.stan likewise)

its observations outside the table: jaws.stan's Y, the 20 x 4 jaw measures at the four ages, is no column of the table, which holds the age vector and the 4 x 4 scale matrix S of the inverse-Wishart prior

its long form, participant by rater, holds three raters' categorizations (1 to 4) of each participant's probability-rating pattern; analysis.Rmd binds only the derived agreement columns (min_two, all) to the per-participant model fits for chi-square tests, so the paper fits no model on the ratings

its long form, subject by language (the L1 and L2 self-ratings of listening, speaking, reading and writing), is fit by nothing: conversational_switching_data_analysis.R merges only lextale into the per-subject lm(lang_dom ~ lextale_c) and lm(asym_switch_costs ~ lextale_c)

its long form, drug by sample, holds the Helsinki AML study's selective DSS (healthy-normalized) of 515 drugs, from the deposit the paper cites as that study's original publication; the paper's LMMs (y ~ exp_var + (1 + exp_var | drug) + (1 | patient)) fit Box-Cox transformed, z-scaled DSS2 over pooled cohorts with experimental variables this table lacks, as the deposit's other files were filed
its long form, gene by sample, holds the cited Helsinki cohort's batch-corrected log2 CPM; no model of the paper uses expression data, as File_8's raw counts were filed

the long form, month x sector, is the monthly employment and hourly wage of eleven industries named by their codes (emp232 and wage232 to emp056 and wage056), the low-wage sectors Wolfson and Belman (2004) chose, a few fixed series over 612 months (t) beside the federal minimum wage, CPI and unemployment; the derived columns are the growth rates of sectors 232, 236, 234 and 314 and twelve lags of minimum wage growth for the text's time-series regressions (pages 379, 410, 444-445, 674-675), and no sector is sampled from a population (as AER GoldSilver)

the long form, year x species, is the arrival and laying dates of three seabird species (AP, CP and EP) beside the MSA and SOI climate series, a few exhaustive series, and no unit is sampled from a population (as AER GoldSilver); the pinned zip holds no model code, and Zuur et al. (2009, ch. 14) estimate these birds' trends in relation to climate (recalled)

the long form, year x series, is the abundance of five species-island series (stilts and coots on Oahu and Maui, moorhens on Kauai) beside one rainfall series, a few exhaustive series, and no unit is sampled from a population (as AER GoldSilver); Zuur et al. (2009, ch. 6) fit gls with an AR-1 correlation over the years to the Kauai moorhen series (recalled), no random effect

the long form, year x species, is the counts of seven named wader species in one estuary beside the catchment's crop, livestock and nitrate series, a few exhaustive series rather than a sample of species (as DAAG jobs' regions); the pinned zip holds no model code, and the empty Unnamed columns hold nothing
